## Additional Features - **Building Collision** — A buildings index is included for all non-filtered buildings, assigning each a flat foundation depth of **−10 m** in-game. This provides underground collision geometry so that tunnels interact correctly with building footprints. - **Water Depth Index** — A water depth index restricts track placement in water bodies. Coastal bundles include a real bathymetric layer derived from EMODnet Bathymetry (1/16 arc-min DTM, ~115 m resolution); inland water (rivers, lakes, canals) uses a flat **−4 m** index that prevents surface-level track placement. - **Ocean Foundations** — A depth-colored ocean floor layer is included for coastal bundles, providing a visual representation of Baltic Sea bathymetry visible on the in-game map. - **Place Name Labels** — Two layers of place name labels are embedded in the map: - _City labels_ — Major Polish cities at the metropolitan scale (gminy miejskie within Functional Urban Areas). - _Municipality labels_ — Names of all gminy within the map boundary. ## Methodology This map is generated through a six-phase pipeline that transforms Polish government census and employment statistics into georeferenced origin/destination demand points. **Point Seeding:** Candidate points are placed within each _rejon statystyczny_ (sub-municipal census unit, BREC) using population-weighted centroids derived from a hybrid 125 m / 250 m / 1 km mesh — GUS NSP 2021 published gridded population at native resolution where available, and a GHS-POP 100 m raster (JRC R2023A) gated by a BDOT10k residential building mask in dense urban tiles. **Mesh Reconciliation:** Initial point populations are refined by solving a constrained convex optimization that approximates each point's mass to residential and economic mesh ideals while preserving NSP 2021 (_Narodowy Spis Powszechny 2021_) per-rejon population totals. **Aggregation:** A global scaling factor reconciles the mismatch between boundary-captured employed residents (from NSP 2021) and workplace employees (from GUS BDL _pracujący_ statistics by PKD industry section), since commuters cross the FUA boundary in both directions. **Commute Assignment:** Commute flows are assigned using a gravity model with distance-decay. Per-gmina origin-destination targets are taken from the GUS NSP 2021 commuter matrix; an iterative calibration loop adjusts gmina-pair multipliers until simulated commute shares converge to the observed flows. Where available (Warsaw _WBR 2015_, Wrocław _KBR 2018_), a sub-gmina rejon × rejon overlay is layered on top of the gmina-level assignment. **Special Demand Injection:** Non-commuter demand generators — airports, universities, tourism attractions, sports leagues, theatres, and convention centers — are injected as an additive layer. Airport demand from ULC (_Urząd Lotnictwa Cywilnego_) statistics; university demand from POL-on (_Zintegrowany System Informacji o Szkolnictwie Wyższym_) registry × GUS public CSV per-institution enrollment scaled by the national stacjonarni share (full-time student fraction); attraction demand from POT (_Polska Organizacja Turystyczna_) annual-visitor reports across all 16 _województwa_ (~960 attractions). Sports league demand is per-club average attendance × home matches across Ekstraklasa football, PHL ice hockey, PlusLiga volleyball, and Superliga handball; cultural-venue and convention-center demand from operator annual reports and PIPT (_Polski Związek Organizatorów Targów_) aggregates. **Layout Reconciliation:** A final spatial pass resolves point overlaps and ensures map clickability while keeping special-demand locations fixed. ## Data Sources All demand modeling is derived from freely available Polish government statistical datasets and public geospatial resources. ### Census & Demographics - **2021 Census** (_Narodowy Spis Powszechny Ludności i Mieszkań 2021_ / NSP 2021) — [GUS / Statistics Poland](https://stat.gov.pl/) - **Per-rejon Census Population** (BREC + obwody spisowe) — [GUS NSP 2021](https://stat.gov.pl/) - **Commute O/D at gmina level** (_macierz przepływów ludności związanych z zatrudnieniem_) — [GUS NSP 2021](https://stat.gov.pl/) - **Workplace Employment Statistics** (_pracujący_ by PKD industry section, BDL P4457) — [GUS BDL / Bank Danych Lokalnych](https://bdl.stat.gov.pl/) - **Sub-gmina commute surveys** (where available) — [Warsaw WBR 2015](https://transport.um.warszawa.pl/) · [Wrocław KBR 2018](https://www.wroclaw.pl/) ### Geospatial Reference - **100 m Population Grid** (GHS-POP R2023A) — [JRC / EU Copernicus](https://ghsl.jrc.ec.europa.eu/) - **Administrative Boundaries** (PRG _Państwowy Rejestr Granic_ — gminy + powiaty + województwa) — [GUGiK](https://www.gugik.gov.pl/) - **BREC Rejon Polygons** (_rejon statystyczny / obwód spisowy_ census units) — [GUS INSPIRE](https://geo.stat.gov.pl/) - **Building Polygons & Use Classification** (BDOT10k _kodKst_ codes — kodKst=110 residential, 107 services, etc.) — [GUGiK](https://www.geoportal.gov.pl/) - **Functional Urban Area Boundaries** (URAU 2021 FUA polygons, gmina-aggregated) — [Eurostat GISCO](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/gisco) + [GUS TERCET](https://stat.gov.pl/) - **Bathymetry** (EMODnet Bathymetry DTM, 1/16 arc-min — coastal bundles only) — [EMODnet Bathymetry Consortium](https://emodnet.ec.europa.eu/en/bathymetry) - **Overture Maps Foundation** (auxiliary building footprint side-channel for the BDOT10k height cascade) — [Overture](https://overturemaps.org/) ### Special Demand Statistics - **Airport Passenger Statistics** (terminal-level annual passengers) — [ULC / Urząd Lotnictwa Cywilnego](https://ulc.gov.pl/pl/statystyki-analizy) - **University Registry** (POL-on institutional metadata) — [POL-on](https://radon.nauka.gov.pl/) - **University Enrollment** (per-institution headcount) — [GUS Higher Education](https://stat.gov.pl/obszary-tematyczne/edukacja/) - **University Geocoding** (CAPAP — _Centralna Aplikacja Geokodowania Adresów Pocztowych_) — [GUGiK CAPAP / UUG](https://www.gugik.gov.pl/) - **Tourism Visitor Statistics** (POT annual ~960-attraction roll-up) — [Polska Organizacja Turystyczna](https://www.pot.gov.pl/) - **Football League Attendance** (Ekstraklasa) — [ekstraklasa.org](https://www.ekstraklasa.org/) - **Ice Hockey League Attendance** (PHL — _Polska Hokej Liga_) — [phl.pl](https://www.phl.pl/) - **Volleyball League Attendance** (PlusLiga) — [plusliga.pl](https://www.plusliga.pl/) - **Handball League Attendance** (Superliga) — [pgnig-superliga.pl](https://www.pgnig-superliga.pl/) - **Convention & Exhibition Centers** (PIPT-tracked venues) — [Polska Izba Przemysłu Targowego](https://www.pipt.pl/) ## License This map data is released under the [GNU General Public License v3.0](https://github.com/ahkimn/subwaybuilder-eu-maps/blob/main/LICENSE). ## Credits Map authored by [Yukina-](https://subwaybuildermodded.com/credits/)
